notes: Corrected the disposal of the article hā on ʿAy for the same reason as the article on the rectum elsewhere: the ASV does write a *the* for this chain, so rule 29's narrow condition for `unrepresented` is not met and the present article takes it ahead of a supplied one.

The competing reading is stronger here than in a simple chain, because the article stands on the second conjunct of a compound rectum whose first member is an anarthrous proper name; it is recorded in full in the s005 note.
